per_hop.query:
SELECT PhilipSavage.position, BaltimoreRavens.GM, SteveLittle.draft_position, GeneralManager.draft_position, GeneralManager.college_hall_of_fame, GeneralManager.pro_hall_of_fame
FROM Personnel as PhilipSavage
JOIN Teams as BaltimoreRavens ON PhilipSavage.team = BaltimoreRavens.name
JOIN Players as SteveLittle ON SteveLittle.name = 'Steve Little'
JOIN Players as GeneralManager ON GeneralManager.name = BaltimoreRavens.GM
WHERE PhilipSavage.position = 'Director of Player Personnel' AND PhilipSavage.team = 'Baltimore Ravens';
